'''Corlir''' was a [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] with a [[Gender/Legends|masculine]] personality who was the leader of the [[Vanderijar]] [[Kajidic/Legends|Hutt clan]] around the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Corlier represented Vanderijar on the [[Grand Hutt Council/Legends|Hutt Ruling Council]] and though he was outspoken and assertive, his influence on the Council was hindered by Vanderijar's aggressive [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggling]] strategy and run-ins with the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. As a result, Corlir faced heavy criticsm from among the Hutts to step down from the Ruling Council before Vanderijar triggered an Imperial crackdown against the Hutts.<ref name="Lords of Nal Hutta" />
